title: 3+3+2 block as B-section contrast drive
summary: A continuous 4–8 bar 3+3+2 run marks B or variación as contrast_drive—denser and more forward-leaning than marcato home—then the groove must return clearly to marcato for A′.
engine_hint: b_groove_contrast_run=true; run_length 4 or 8 aligned to phrase; bookend with ≥1 bar home before and after.
